summary.en-US: Live Cursor usage, budget tracker & local security scanner in your browser.

description.en-US:
**Cursor Curse Monitor by Lorapok** shows your Cursor AI usage, budget cap, billing cycle reset, and spend-over-time trend — right in your browser toolbar.

### Key features

- Animated budget gauge with threshold warnings
- Auto & API usage meters
- Local security scanner on token paste — warns if extra secrets appear
- Connect automatically via [cursor.com/dashboard](https://cursor.com/dashboard) or paste a token manually
- Tokens stay on your device — never sent to Lorapok servers

### Technical details

- **Permissions:** `storage`, `alarms`, `notifications`, and `cursor.com` / `api2.cursor.sh` hosts only
- **Auth:** content script captures Bearer token from cursor.com; manual paste fallback in Options
- **Data:** usage metrics read from Cursor API with your token; optional anonymous heartbeat is off by default
- **License:** Mozilla Public License 2.0
- **Privacy policy:** [cursor.lorapok.tech/privacy.html](https://cursor.lorapok.tech/privacy.html)
- **Support:** [cursor.curse.help@lorapok.tech](mailto:cursor.curse.help@lorapok.tech)

**Also available on:** [Open VSX](https://open-vsx.org/extension/lorapok-labs/cursor-curse-monitor-by-lorapok), [VS Code Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=LorapokLabs.cursor-curse-monitor-by-lorapok), [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Maijied/Cursor-Curse-Monitor-by-Lorapok/releases), [Product website](https://cursor.lorapok.tech/).

A product of [Lorapok Labs](https://lorapok.tech). Built for [Cursor](https://cursor.com) users.

developer_comments.en-US:
How to test:
1. Install the extension.
2. Sign in at https://cursor.com/dashboard in the same browser profile.
3. Open the toolbar popup — usage should load within one refresh.
4. Alternatively: Options → paste access token manually.

Technical whiteboard:
- MV3 background scripts (Firefox 142+), no remote code
- Auth capture: cursor.com content script → api2.cursor.sh Bearer token only
- Storage: browser.storage.local for settings and usage history
- Notifications: local threshold warnings only
- No Lorapok server receives tokens unless user opts into product email updates
